propositions: docs/exit-codes.md declares itself single source of truth but documents only 41 of 75 real dispatcher commands, with 34 omissions including review-plan, review-code, and verify-completion
Exit codes 75 (RebaseGuard/EXIT_RESCHEDULE), 78 (StoreIncompatibleError), 3, 4, and 12 are used by the CLI but undocumented in the exit codes table
Documentation states only five commands validate unknown options but metrics, doctor, composer, and fsck all exit 2 on unknown options today
No CI check exists to enforce that every new dispatcher command has a corresponding row in the exit codes document
Exit code semantics are not machine-readable and must be manually maintained as commands are added or behaviors change
